title: ENACT: Evaluating Embodied Cognition with World Modeling of Egocentric Interaction

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model performance on forward and inverse world modeling tasks while systematically altering camera configurations, such as field of view (FOV), aperture, fisheye lens, and camera height, to measure accuracy degradation when viewpoints deviate from standard human-like perspectives.
Analyzing predicate-level errors in the model's predicted actions to compare precision, recall, and hand-mixing error rates between left-handed and right-handed robotic interactions.

Testing model performance robustness by altering the visual appearance of the agent's embodiment in the simulator (e.g., rendering the robot with white color, random colors, or a human-like skin tone).
